symptom: Rewriting a Studio Pro workflow drops the empty Flow and the PersistentId of every outcome that leads nowhere, writes RelativeMiddlePoint/Size "" where Studio Pro stores "0;0", and deletes an empty EventSubProcesses [2]
cause: The writer added an outcome's Flow only when non-nil (Workflows$Outcome.flow is Required), gave condition outcomes no PersistentId, and omitted an empty EventSubProcesses list because the property is version-floored (11.8)
fix: Always write an outcome Flow; PersistentId on every outcome; "0;0" layout; empty EventSubProcesses via MandatoryListMarkers, suppressed through Encoder.OmitKeys below 11.8 only when the workflow has none (MandatoryListMarkers now honours OmitKeys)
insight: Encoder.OmitKeys suppresses a key whatever it holds, so version-floor only the empty default: suppressing the key outright would drop declared sub-processes on a project whose version could not be read
